## Functions

### `translate`

```ts
translate(text: string, options: TranslateOptions): Promise<Translation>
translate(texts: string[], options: TranslateOptions): Promise<Translation[]>
```

| Parameter | Description | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | The text to translate. | `string` | Yes |
| `options` | Languages and load mode. | [`TranslateOptions`](#translateoptions) | Yes |

## Interfaces and types

### `TranslateOptions`

| Field | Description | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `to` | Target language. | `string` | Yes |
| `from` | Source language; detected when omitted. | `string` | No |
| `mode` | How the model loads. | `"eager" \| "lazy"` | No |
